description: A snapshot taken over another tree of a source is a miss, never a stale restore: the state is the real refresh with lib/notes.txt holding notes; one byte of it has since changed (notez), so lib's identity differs from the one the snapshot records even though data.kdl, its revision, and the snapshot key are unchanged; its one record line was edited after the refresh to hold locale nb-no where the reading binds sv-se (the payload digest restamped), so a restore prints nb-no and a replay prints sv-se. The record prints sv-se: the read replayed. It is the same state as processing/read-data-entry-restore-source-hit's, which restores, so the changed byte alone decides the miss
